scope: Barangay-centroid anchors for the AI-assisted NIA geolocation layer; one anchor per located row, not a surveyed project site.

metadata.method: Mean of polygon vertices (lon, lat), WGS84. Barangay polygon when the PSGC is barangay-level; municipality polygon (Municities layer) when the PSGC is the municipality code itself (suffix 00) — flagged municipality_level_anchor.
